adjudication.rationale: `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts` returns the raw `fetch()` `Response` from `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` without checking `response.ok` or parsing/validating the body. Call sites then treat the result as a successful token response (e.g., Google Calendar does `const token = res?.data;` after `refreshOAuthTokens(...)`, but a `fetch` `Response` has no `.data`, and 4xx/5xx responses are not rejected). This can silently propagate error responses / wrong shapes downstream and break token refresh behavior.
